# Assumptions

Every value the model uses that is **not** taken from a cited source (108 of 172 ledger records). `ask_team` marks values the ASTRO-USA team can replace with facts.

| Ledger path | Value | Unit | Ask team | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cfd.turbulence_model` | kEpsilon | - | no | Chosen from the IEA Annex 20 2-D isothermal validation (results/cfd/annex20.md): with the habitat cases' wall functions and schemes, standard k-epsilon reproduced the measured floor return flow and ceiling-jet separation that kOmegaSST missed, at every mesh tested. Isothermal evidence only (the buoyant Annex 20 case has no data). Runs built before 2026-10-13 15:00 used kOmegaSST (their case files and ledger digest record it). User decision 2026-10-13. |
| `container.length_discrepancy_placement` | door end | - | yes | Fig 2 length (464 in = 11785.6 mm) is 246.4 mm shorter than the steel interior (12032 mm). Unexplained (end framing? door-end wall?); the gap is placed at the door end for the exterior shell only. |
